'Sometimes he wants to leave' - De Zerbi on Richarlison's Spurs future. Roberto de Zerbi says Tottenham "don't know" whether Richarlison will stay or leave, as he "sometimes" wants to leave.
Mudryk Chelsea return will take time - Alonso. Xabi Alonso says he is "very happy" to be welcoming Mykhailo Mudryk back into his Chelsea squad, but it is "too early" to understand what he can do.
Bournemouth sign Portugal defender Silva. Portugal defender Antonio Silva says he excited to win with Bournemouth after signing for the Cherries in a deal worth up to almost £26m.
Chelsea fined £10m but avoid suspended points deduction. Chelsea are fined £10m by the Football Association for breaching rules relating to payments to agents between 2009 and 2022.

Howe going as spending rules bite - troubles for Newcastle's Saudi owners. Newcastle United wanted to become one of the world's top clubs under their Saudi owners - but Eddie Howe's decision to leave is a sign of the troubles they are facing.
Bournemouth agree £26m fee for Benfica defender Silva. Bournemouth agree a deal worth up to almost £26m for Benfica centre-back Antonio Silva.

Gold family agree to sell West Ham stake to Staveley. Former West Ham co-owner David Gold's daughter Vanessa confirms plans to sell shares to a consortium headed by ex-Newcastle co-owner Amanda Staveley.

McAidoo 'the kind of winger I love' -  Maresca. Despite Manchester City's penalty-shootout defeat by Inter Milan, teenager Ryan McAidoo grabs the opportunity to show manager Enzo Maresca what he can do.
Highlights: Dundee Utd 1-1 Rangers. Derek McInnes' era as Rangers manager got off to an underwhelming start as Dundee United hold them to an opening Scottish Premiership draw.
Arsenal agree Guimaraes fee - Saturday's gossip. Arsenal and Newcastle agree Bruno Guimaraes fee, Inter Milan increase Curtis Jones bid and Cristian Romero explores Spanish move, plus more.

Staveley-led consortium agrees deal for minority stake in West Ham. Vanessa Gold has confirmed she has agreed to sell her stake in the club to a consortium led by former Newcastle co-owner Amanda Staveley.

Warrington go fourth with comprehensive win over Castleford. Warrington Wolves moved up to fourth in the Betfred Super League table after recovering from a lacklustre start to claim a comprehensive 48-18 win at Castleford Tigers .
Everton latest: Toffees interested in Man Utd youngster Wheatley.

Bellingham watches Phoenix seal first Hundred win as Brave stay perfect. Birmingham Phoenix won their first match in The Hundred 2026 women's competition in dramatic fashion, defeating Welsh Fire with just one ball remaining as investor Jude Bellingham watched on.

Crowley to retire from riding and start training. Jim Crowley has called time on his illustrious riding career having failed to recover sufficiently from a serious injury he suffered in a fall at York in September.

'I played like a 10-handicapper!' - Hull fights back to stay in major hunt. Charley Hull is relishing the opportunity to make a late push for major victory after spectacular late third-round fightback at the AIG Women’s Open.

Woad, Hull chase Noh after Ryu blows big AIG Women's Open lead. Yealimi Noh capitalised on Haeran Ryu's stumble to grab the third-round lead at the AIG Women’s Open, where Lottie Woad and Charley Hull stayed in title contention.
Bournemouth sign defender Silva from Benfica. Bournemouth have completed the signing of Portugal international defender Antonio Silva from Benfica.
